scope: CPU-only component validation of opt-in independent public tail-alignment rotations, including runtime-policy archive compatibility.
checks: Serial and parallel in-place public rotations match byte for byte across all tail blocks and tested column counts.
The evaluator receives the expected factor modulus and callbacks execute inside an active OpenMP team.
Backend exceptions are caught in workers and rethrown on the caller; malformed batch geometry is rejected.
A zero-valued public key archive resets the runtime parallel policy on load without changing the legacy serialized field list.
Existing exact-RNS and digit-CRT factor checks continue to pass.
Toggling the runtime policy leaves serialized public-key bytes identical.
scheduling: Interleave columns of the same block to let adjacent workers share the prepared exponent cache.
callback_contract: Opt in only with a thread-safe public evaluator. OpenMP nesting follows the caller policy; this test uses one active level.
